summary: Addentax Group Corp. filed an 8-K/A to include financials of Keemo Fashion Group Ltd. after acquiring 34.2M shares (approximately 62.18% voting control) for $5.5M. Consideration is satisfied via partial transfer of an existing bond (original principal $17.5M, 2.5% interest, one-year tenor renewable). The stock purchase agreement was entered February 17, 2026, with closing by May 1, 2026. The board approved the transaction; no advisor named. As a controlling stake purchase using bond transfer, watch for regulatory review (if any) and risk that the bond's terms or recoverability affect deal value.
